course.title: Fundamentals of Planning Process
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: You have been appointed as an intern in RAJUK (Rajdhani Unnayan (20) Kartripakkha). You are assigned for the following assignment.

Dhaka City has experienced a number of devastating fire incidents in recent months. The incidents killed/ injured many people and caused financial loss to the nation. On the other hand, national media, experts and general people blamed RAJUK for the incidents. RAJUK wants to take initiatives associated with other Government agencies for minimizing the extent of the fire incidents. Now you have to do the following tasks. Try to conceptualize your ideas in short. Task 1: Prepare a Vision for solving the problem (please clarify your idea).
Task 2: What might be the Mission according to your Vision (please discuss briefly).
Task 3: According to your Vision and Mission, formulate some Programmes.
Task 4: Mention some projects (i.e., your suggestion as project) under the one Programme.
Task 5: Clarify Goal, Objectives and Strategies of any three projects among your mentioned project.
